evals.prompt: Prepare the planning. The next sprint is atypical, focus will be lower.
evals.expected_output: Reduced commitment range compared to normal, with the adjustment explained.
expectations: The recommended range is visibly below the average velocity (not 19-21 pts)
The output explains that the adjustment comes from the focus relative to the baseline
Effective person-days appear as a diagnostic, not as the origin of the range

evals.prompt: Propose the candidate scope in priority order.
evals.expected_output: Scope that respects rank and puts the rest in the queue.
expectations: The candidate scope does not include a lower-ranked story by skipping a higher-ranked one that does not fit
Stories that do not make it in appear as next in queue, in rank order
The output presents the scope as a candidate, for the team to decide

evals.prompt: New team, first sprint. How much can we commit to?
evals.expected_output: No invented points range; asks about recent delivery.
expectations: Does NOT propose a points range
Returns the effective person-days and explains why it does not convert days into points
Asks the team what it delivered in the last sprints
The unestimated story is listed separately and does not enter the scope

evals.prompt: Prepare the planning: we permanently lost a person since the velocity sprints.
evals.expected_output: Range adjusted for headcount, with a note.
expectations: The range is adjusted downward for the headcount change
A note indicates the headcount change versus the velocity sprints
The range method (observed min-max x availability) is made explicit

evals.prompt: The team thinks this sprint will have very high focus, 0.95. How much can we commit to?
evals.expected_output: Range capped at the best recorded delivery, with a warning that extrapolation would exceed the history.
expectations: The upper bound of the range does not exceed the best recorded delivery (25 pts)
The output explicitly warns that the availability adjustment pointed to a value above the history
The warning appears in a highlighted warnings block, not as a neutral note
The output flags that the focus factor 0.95 is outside the typical range 0.5–0.9
The candidate scope is not filled to a value above the historical maximum

evals.expected_output: Warning that there are no ready stories, instead of an empty candidate scope presented as normal.
expectations: The output warns that there are no ready stories in the input
Does not present an empty candidate scope as if it were a valid proposal
Instructs to confirm the board and the top-of-backlog JQL
The warning is propagated to the delivered pack
